(a) Monthly subscription fees are non-refundable once the billing cycle begins.
(b) Failure to pay renewal charges may result in account suspension after:

(ii) Read-only access restriction for an additional 14 days.

Article 6: Third-Party Services. Integrations with third-party tools and cookies are governed by their respective terms.
